response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(`ANA Pattern`), '') AS pattern, `aCL IgG` AS igg FROM Examination), group_avg AS (SELECT pattern, AVG(igg) AS avg_igg FROM grp GROUP BY pattern), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS mean_avg FROM group_avg), kept AS (SELECT g.pattern, g.avg_igg, g.avg_igg - o.mean_avg AS above_mean FROM group_avg g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_igg > o.mean_avg) SELECT k.pattern, k.avg_igg, k.above_mean, k.avg_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept k ORDER BY k.avg_igg DESC;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL or blank/whitespace-only ANA Pattern is treated as 'no recorded pattern' and forms one group; the schema and documentation do not say how empty strings are stored.
The mean of all group averages is an unweighted mean over groups. Groups whose aCL IgG values are all missing have a NULL average, so they are excluded from that mean and cannot be kept.
The mean of the kept patterns' averages is also unweighted over kept groups, and the 'how far above' and 'how far from' differences are signed (average minus mean).

alternatives.interpretation: Treat only a true NULL as 'no recorded pattern'. Empty or whitespace-only pattern strings stay as their own separate groups instead of being merged with NULL.
